consequence.statement: The wireguard.userspaceFallback setting is no longer honoured; the userspace fallback is gone, so WireGuard encryption requires a Linux kernel with WireGuard support.
consequence.remediation: Remove wireguard.userspaceFallback from values and ensure nodes run a Linux kernel with WireGuard support.

assertion.statement: The deprecated Helm value wireguard.userspaceFallback (built-in WireGuard userspace-mode fallback) has been removed; WireGuard transparent encryption now requires a Linux kernel with WireGuard support.

checks.detail: the subject and change are not both confirmed by an artifact validator (subject refuted)
